mechanism: Erythromycin may increase hydrochlorothiazide levels through CYP3A4 inhibition, while hydrochlorothiazide can cause electrolyte depletion that potentiates macrolide-induced QT prolongation.
action: Monitor electrolytes (particularly potassium and magnesium) and cardiac function; consider alternative antibiotic if possible, especially in patients with baseline QT prolongation or electrolyte abnormalities.
